Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1460
Claimant:
Monica Stout
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
05/26/2024
Claim received for a side impact at an intersection involving our insured vehicle. The claimant is represented by
counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
06/17/2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver of the vehicle is named on it. Coverage was in force on the date of loss,
and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the coverage period.
07/03/2024
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Two independent
witnesses describe the crash in the same sequence the claimant gave.
07/17/2024
Photos from the scene and the other driver's statement agree with the reported accident sequence. The damage to
the vehicle is mostly consistent with the described side impact, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
07/25/2024
Counsel submitted the medical file showing a wrist fracture. The injury fits the kind and force of a side impact of this
type, and no prior injury to the same area appears in the records we have.
09/01/2024
The claimant has given the same account of the collision in each conversation so far, including the initial call, the
recorded statement, and the follow-up through counsel.
09/02/2024
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. The provider notes show steady
improvement, and visit frequency has tapered as the patient recovered.
10/20/2024
Reviewed the bills and treatment timeline against the injury. The care pattern is consistent with a standard recovery
for this fracture, and no unusual gaps or escalations appear.
01/05/2025
File is in order on liability, damage, injury and coverage. Next step is to finalize the injury evaluation with counsel and
set a settlement conference.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
